import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalTaylorCoefficients
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset

/-!
# Finite Taylor expansion in a local parameter

In the local domain and coefficient-field setting of `localTaylorCoefficient`,
the first `n` coefficients reconstruct an element modulo the `n`th power of
the specified parameter. The remainder is the `n`th iterate of the local
Taylor remainder map. All constructions retain the specified parameter.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Hartshorne

open IsLocalRing
open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {k R : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (c0 : R →ₗ[k] k)
  (hc0 : ∀ a : R, residue R (algebraMap k R (c0 a)) = residue R a)
  (t : R) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t})

/-- Finite Taylor expansion with its explicitly iterated remainder. -/
theorem eq_sum_localTaylorCoefficient_add_remainder (n : ℕ) (a : R) :
    a = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        algebraMap k R (localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht i a) * t ^ i) +
      t ^ n * (localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht ^ n) a := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hrem := mul_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht
      ((localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht ^ n) a)
    change t * localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht
        ((localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht ^ n) a) =
      (localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht ^ n) a -
        algebraMap k R (localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n a) at hrem
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_succ' (localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht),
      Module.End.mul_apply,
      pow_succ t, mul_assoc, hrem]
    exact ih.trans (by ring)

/-- The first `n` Taylor coefficients vanish exactly when the element is
divisible by the `n`th power of the specified parameter. -/
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_lt_eq_zero_iff_pow_dvd (n : ℕ) (a : R) :
    (∀ i < n, localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht i a = 0) ↔ t ^ n ∣ a := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht ^ n) a, ?_⟩
    have hs : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
        algebraMap k R (localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht i a) * t ^ i) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      rw [h i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi), map_zero, zero_mul]
    simpa only [hs, zero_add] using
      eq_sum_localTaylorCoefficient_add_remainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n a
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩ i hi
    exact localTaylorCoefficient_parameter_pow_mul_eq_zero c0 hc0 t ht0 ht hi b

/-- Equality of the first `n` Taylor coefficients is equivalent to congruence
modulo the `n`th power of the specified parameter. -/
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_lt_eq_iff_pow_dvd_sub (n : ℕ) (a b : R) :
    (∀ i < n, localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht i a =
      localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht i b) ↔ t ^ n ∣ a - b := by
  rw [← localTaylorCoefficient_lt_eq_zero_iff_pow_dvd c0 hc0 t ht0 ht]
  simp only [map_sub, sub_eq_zero]

end
end Hartshorne
